in_marathi.name: Subhiksha
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे Prosperity, Fortune, Wealth
in_marathi.long_meaning: Subhiksha हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। The name Subhiksha is derived from the Sanskrit word 'subhika', which means prosperity, fortune, and wealth. In Hindu mythology, Subhiksha is considered a form of the goddess Lakshmi, who is the goddess of wealth and prosperity. The name is believed to bring good fortune and abundance to the bearer.

vedic_reference.note: Subhiksha is a modern Sanskrit name derived from the Sanskrit word भिक्षा (bhiksha) meaning 'fortune' or 'prosperity'. It is composed of the prefix सु-su (good) and the root भिक्ष-bhiksha. In Hindu mythology, Bhiksha is also the name of a demon king and a goddess.
